title: Piano2Pop: Expanding Piano Demos into Pop Productions Without Aligned Supervision
abstract: arXiv:2610.31510v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce Piano2Pop, a music-expansion task that transforms piano MIDI into instrumental pop productions. Enabled by recent advances in music generation and polyphonic music transcription, our pseudo-supervised approach conditions a pretrained flow-matching model on piano rolls without aligned piano-pop supervision. We train on synthetic piano-instrumental pairs derived from pop recordings, comparing pair-free transcription, including function-selective (FST) and register-density (RDA) augmentations, with a pair-supervised piano-cover generator as pseudo-demo sources. On 476 testing real-world piano-cover/pop pairs, the pair-supervised approach achieves the best Frechet Audio Distance, Accompaniment Prompt Adherence, and spectral shape on real-piano inputs, while FST mitigates piano-heavy outputs in pair-free training and remains a promising alternative. translated_title: Piano2Pop：无需对齐监督将钢琴演示扩展为流行音乐制作
translated_abstract: 我们提出了Piano2Pop，这是一项音乐扩展任务，可将钢琴MIDI转换为器乐流行音乐作品。得益于音乐生成与多声部音乐转录领域的最新进展，我们的伪监督方法以钢琴卷帘（piano roll）为条件对预训练的流匹配模型进行调控，而无需对齐的钢琴-流行音乐配对监督。我们在从流行音乐录音中派生的合成钢琴-器乐配对数据上进行训练，将无配对转录方法（包括功能选择性增强FST和音区密度增强RDA）与配对监督的钢琴翻弹生成器作为伪演示来源进行了比较。在476组真实世界的钢琴翻弹/流行音乐配对测试集上，配对监督方法在真实钢琴输入上取得了最佳的Fréchet音频距离（FAD）、伴奏提示依从性和频谱形状表现；而FST在无配对训练中缓解了钢琴音过重的问题，仍是一种有前景的替代方案。所有微调后的系统均显著优于零样本基线。
tldr: 该论文提出Piano2Pop任务，通过伪监督的流匹配模型将钢琴MIDI扩展为完整的器乐流行音乐制作，无需钢琴与流行音乐的对齐配对监督，且微调后的模型在真实数据上显著优于零样本基线。
en_tdlr: Piano2Pop is a pseudo-supervised flow-matching approach that expands piano MIDI into instrumental pop productions without aligned piano-pop supervision, with fine-tuned models significantly outperforming zero-shot baselines on real-world data.
